text:
sam: Quick heads-up: starting migration of our CI runners to an org-level self-hosted GitHub Actions fleet + OIDC ephemeral creds. Goal is to standardize runner labels, reduce cold-start flakiness, and remove per-repo long-lived tokens.

sam: High level schedule:
- Pilot (small set of repos): 2025-02-03 -> 2025-02-07
- Org enable (opt-out window): 2025-02-10
- Deprecate old runner tags / cleanup: 2025-02-24

aisha: How are we handling secrets? We have a bunch of repos with repo-scoped tokens used in jobs.

sam: We'll use GitHub OIDC -> short-lived role tokens from our token service. No long-lived repo secrets for CI. We provide a helper GH Action that exchanges OIDC for ephemeral creds and writes to the job env.

liam: What about Buildkite-to-GHA adapters? Can teams keep Buildkite for special cases?

sam: Yes. Most CI will move, but teams with custom Buildkite plugins that call infra directly can request a grace period. We're shipping a small shim to translate Buildkite steps into a GHA invocation for common patterns.

devops-bot: [notice] pilot runbook + runner labels: https://internal.redwood.dev/ci/gha-runner-migration-runbook. Nightly smoke tests for pilot repos start 2025-02-04 03:00 UTC.

aisha: Action items for owners: add your repo to the pilot spreadsheet by EOD Thu, confirm a rollback contact, and try the OIDC exchange example in the runbook.

sam: We'll open a migration PR template per repo and host a 30-min sync next Tue 15:00 PT for pilot owners. Ping me or @eng-infra with blockers. :thumbsup:
